features: LUXURY WITH COMFORTABLE SLEEP - Our bed sheets are a more appealing, relaxing and comfortable which gives you the best sleep environment. With our extra deep pocket sheets, you’ll not only sleep in luxury and comfort, but you’ll also get a better night’s sleep. A better night’s sleep can go a long way in improving your health, your body, and your mind.

BREATHABLE WITH SNUGLY FIT - Anyone who has ever suffered from night sweats or simply has difficulty sleeping well when hot, will appreciate the breathability of our bed sheets. The air can flow through the sheets allowing you to rest coolly and comfortably throughout the night when sleeping on our Egyptian cotton sheets. Our Ultra thick full length Elastic stretch snugly fit your mattress which provides close fitting to give you the most comfortable sleeping experience.

SOFTNESS & DURABILITY – A major noticeable benefit of our bed sheets is that it offers softness. Through simply touching the product, shoppers and users can experience the suppleness and smoothness of Egyptian cotton as compared to products made using a cotton mixture. When properly care for, Our sheets will last longer than other sheets on the market today, as long as they are maintained properly.

COST EFFECTIVENESS - Our Egyptian cotton sheets are an investment. High quality Egyptian cotton sheets are not exactly cheap sheets. However, if you care for them properly, they will outlast less expensive linen sheets, sometimes lasting decades, making them cost considerably less over the span of their lifetime. If you’ve never experienced the near perfect experience of sleeping on Egyptian cotton sheets, you’re in for a real treat.

NO PILLING – Pilling creates little pills of fabric that can be not only unsightly, but also uncomfortable. You’ll find them often in cal sheet set of lower quality or lower thread counts, but you will not find them in our sheets as they are made with Egyptian cotton. Fibers from the Egyptian cotton plant are longer and produce little (if any) lint, which makes pilling unlikely.
description: Welcome To The World of Luxurious Sheets In Soft Sateen & Durable Long-Staple Cotton

Our Bedding Collection has endured for well over a century and is now available for the modern home.  You'll sleep easy on our beautiful bed sheet sets, with linens that feel decadent and delicate to the touch. Our finely-made bed sheet sets consist of a top and bottom sheet, plus two pillowcases. Your cozy nest can be lined with what feels best against your skin: fresh, breathable, lightweight, crisp, smooth, lustrous cotton sateen.

Our Sheets are woven using 100% Combed Compact Egyptian Cotton yarn. Compact is the latest spinning technology superior to the combed process which eliminates the short fiber surfaces and impurities. The longest and straightest fiber once woven gives the much smoother and quality fabrics.

A sateen weave is one vertical thread woven for every four horizontal threads. This type of weave produces a fabric with a lustrous look and satin feel.   Mostly sateen weave are associated with higher thread counts wherein the finest yarn counts are used to achieve the optimum hand feel. The construction of Sateen weave is generally four yarns over, one yarn under which gives the softy silky hand feel.   All our sheets are made out of soft sateen weave which gives the utmost comfort sleep and keep you cool through the night.
Unique 4 way Elastic all around at the head and foot of our fitted sheet gives you a snug, stay-put fit assured to fit low profile, regular and deep mattresses up to 16" without popping off.
Our pillowcases have a flap closure which keeps your pillowcases protected, cover, clean and in place.
Flat Sheet - 108" x 102" Fitted Sheet - 76" x 80" x 16" Pillowcase - 20"x40"
